customManagers.description: Kotlin Toolchain version in the kotlin and kotlin.bat wrappers.
SwiftLint release downloaded by build-logic/swiftlint (not a Maven artifact).

packageRules.description: Merge non-major updates once the required CI checks pass.
AndroidX is published only to Google Maven. Without Gradle files Renovate cannot detect google(), so it would only query Maven Central.
Ktor depends on the -0.6.x-compat variant, so stay on it (see libs.versions.toml).
Skip the Kotlin Toolchain dev and branch builds published to the same repository.
The wrappers pin a SHA-256 checksum that Renovate cannot update, so these PRs need a manual commit.
prBodyNotes: Renovate only bumps the version; the checksum is now stale. Replace this change by running `./kotlin update --target-version={{{newVersion}}}` and pushing the result to this branch.

packageRules.description: plugin.yaml pins SHA-256 checksums of the SwiftLint assets that Renovate cannot update.
prBodyNotes: Update the `sha256` checksums in `build-logic/swiftlint/plugin.yaml` (`digest` of the assets at https://api.github.com/repos/realm/SwiftLint/releases/tags/{{{newVersion}}}) and push them to this branch.
